title: Properness is stable under base change
statement:
If $f:X\to Y$ is proper [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $g:Y'\to Y$ is
arbitrary, then the base change $f':X\times_YY'\to Y'$ is proper.

mathlib_searches.query: proper morphism of schemes is preserved by arbitrary base change, pullback projection
if f : X ⟶ Y is proper and g : Y' ⟶ Y arbitrary, then pullback.snd f g is proper
